subject: Want the code from the presentation on plotting mixed models?

messages.author: 4dee24c578d7691c
messages.subject: Want the code from the presentation on plotting mixed models?
parts:
Hello all,

I presented last week on some ways to plot mixed model results. Please e-mail me - Stella - scop...@ucdavis.edu if you would like the code and associated notes. Also, thanks to Davis Harris who noted that lme4 does have a predict function. If you haven't updated that package lately you may be living in the past, as I was: note to self, update packages before presenting on them (how embarrassing!). Another change to note: mcmcsamp is not implemented in versions of lme4 > 1.0. Again, apologies for the inaccuracies; if you e-mail me you get your paws on code that should work with latest version of lme4.

Also, let me know if you have any feedback/other ways of looking at mixed models - in R that is. Yay for R!
Stella
-- 
Stella Copeland
PhD Candidate
Environmental Science & Policy
UC Davis
